about: The clipboard flyout as Windows 11's clipboard history: "Clipboard history" and "Clear all" at the top, copied text and pictures as cards (newest first), a "..." menu per card, a short message while nothing was copied; no KDE search field, barcode or edit pages, no KDE settings dialog. Klipper's history model stays. Matched against plasma-workspace 6.3.6 (Debian 13).

replacements.why: Windows 11's clipboard history (product owner, 2026-10-22: make the clipboard flyout modern, like Windows 11)
